cs.t: Here is ChatGPT's attempt to reformat the comment above: I have a few things that make my work setup more comfortable and efficient. First, I have a UPS that can run my PC, monitors, and USB hub for 10-30 minutes. I rarely have power outages, but when I do have one, it's a non-event. Next, I have a cheap boom arm for my webcam. It keeps the camera stable and at a good angle. I also use a Stream Deck, which makes it easy to quickly control audio and lights, as well as launch applications. The Tourbox makes it easy to edit video. For video calls, I use Elgato Keylight Airs. They provide great lighting, so I always look my best on camera. I also have Neumi powered speakers for high-quality audio. When it comes to input devices, I use a Corsair K100 keyboard. I love the feel and being able to disable the caps lock key. For a mouse, I use the Logitech MX Vertical. I hate using any other mouse at this point. To improve my audio experience, I use a Syba Sonic USB DAC, which provides better audio to my headphones and has a big volume knob. For calls, I use Jabra Evolve2 30 wired headset. They are comfortable, and I don't need to charge them. Since they are USB-C, I can even plug them into my phone for longer calls. When I want to listen or work on video, I use my Audio-Technica ATH M50 headphones. They are great for isolating sound, and I have an under-desk headphone mount that makes it convenient to grab them.
